original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚贡贝州消防部门承诺加强旱季火灾应急响应
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚联邦消防局与贡贝州消防局承诺加强合作，以预防火灾并改善2026年旱季（Harmattan）期间的应急响应。贡贝州消防局局长Idi Musa Kwami率团访问联邦消防局贡贝州指挥部，商讨应对旱季火灾风险上升的策略。联邦消防局方面表示愿与州消防部门及其他利益相关方合作提升消防安全。该消息目前仅来自单一来源。

location.site: 联邦消防局贡贝州指挥部总部

key_facts.fact: 联邦消防局与贡贝州消防局承诺加强合作以预防火灾并改善应急响应
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Federal Fire Service has reaffirmed its commitment to strengthening collaboration with the Gombe State Fire Service to prevent fire outbreaks and improve emergency response ahead of the 2026 Harmattan season.

key_facts.fact: 贡贝州消防局局长Idi Musa Kwami率团访问联邦消防局贡贝州指挥部总部
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the Director of the Gombe State Fire Service, Idi Musa Kwami, led a delegation on a courtesy visit to its command headquarters in Gombe.

key_facts.fact: 此次访问旨在商讨应对旱季火灾风险上升的策略
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The visit was aimed at strengthening cooperation between the two agencies and developing strategies to address the increased risk of fire outbreaks during the harmattan season.

uncertainties: 目前仅有一个来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
报道未提及具体火灾事件或伤亡情况
